title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
authors: J. Alayrac, J. Donahue, P. Luc, et al. (27 authors)
before: Vision-language models were trained end to end for specific tasks like captioning.
problem: Retraining a language model for vision throws away its language ability and costs a fortune.
breakthrough: Freeze a pretrained vision encoder and a pretrained language model, and train only cross-attention layers to bridge them.
why: The bridging recipe that made multimodality affordable, and the template LLaVA and others followed.
next: LLaVA did it cheaply and openly; GPT-4V and Gemini made it a product.
inherits: Bolting vision onto a language model by training an adapter between frozen parts.
